answer.reason: Both are regional wireline operators that sell fiber internet, TV and phone to residential households and also sell business services. Both are expanding fiber with state government broadband programs. The only clear difference is geography: Shentel serves the Mid-Atlantic and Appalachia, and Nuvera serves southern Minnesota and northern Iowa.

C:P1.2.text: Nuvera Communication provides residential services and business solutions including fiber internet, digital TV, and more. Find services...

C:P1.3.text: Maximize productivity and have a little fun with speeds up to 8 Gig.

C:P1.4.text: Take your business to the next level with Nuvera’s suite of customized business solutions.

C:P1.5.text: Faster speeds, reliable connections, unlimited data. That’s fiber internet.

C:P1.6.text: We’re committed to bringing the fastest, most reliable connection to every square mile of our area – no matter how hard it might be to reach. That’s why we’re constantly expanding our network with fiber-rich infrastructure that’s built to keep our whole community ready for the future.

C:P1.8.text: From high-speed fiber internet, TV, and phone services for your home to IT, networking, and wholesale solutions for your business – Nuvera has you covered.

C:P1.9.text: Nuvera is committed to expanding fiber coverage across our service area and beyond. Click the link below to stay up to date with our latest progress.

C:P1.10.text: We make staying connected easy with our team of experts, robust network, and cutting-edge technology.

C:P1.11.text: Speeds to meet your needs: Fast internet speeds on our rapidly growing fiber network.

C:P1.12.text: Unlimited data: Browse worry-free with no data limits or overage fees.

C:P1.13.text: Loyal to our communities: Our expert local support teams are here when you need us.

C:P1.14.text: *Limited time offers available to new residential internet customers only.

C:P2.2.text: Enjoy superior products, exceptional technical support, and a commitment to community enrichment. Power your home and business with Nuvera.

C:P2.3.text: More than 120 years of commitment to a future of growth and innovation.

C:P2.4.text: Nuvera is a regional broadband provider delivering premium fiber internet, voice, and television services to residential and business customers. Built on a robust fiber-to-the-premise network, Nuvera connects communities with fast, reliable technology while providing advanced business solutions that help organizations scale securely and efficiently.

C:P2.5.text: As a Fiber Minnesota partner, Nuvera also provides carrier-grade fiber connectivity across Minnesota, supporting wholesale and enterprise customers with 24/7 local technician support.

C:P2.7.text: Now in its fifth year, the initiative has reached 50,000 fiber passings, connecting more than 65% of Nuvera’s residential and business customers. With over 75% of construction complete, Nuvera is on pace to achieve 80% fiber coverage.

C:P2.8.text: Nuvera partners with the State of Minnesota through the Minnesota Border-to-Border Broadband Development Grant Program to expand fiber-to-the-premises (FTTP) infrastructure in rural and underserved areas. These projects are delivering symmetrical 1 Gbps service to homes, farms, and businesses, far exceeding the State’s 2026 broadband speed goal.

C:P2.9.text: Minnesota publicly held corporation under symbol NUVR

C:P2.11.text: Local offices in 10 communities in southern Minnesota and northern Iowa

C:P2.13.text: We are a regional leader in the delivery and integration of evolving information technologies.
